normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one crafting table in Morgan's workshop and turns toward Riley's workshop.

normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts spare tools in the shared chest.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a marker block beside the signal lamp.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks into Riley's workshop area. Morgan breaks Riley's oak door, breaks the item frame holding Riley's iron pickaxe, opens Riley's chest, removes several tool items, drops the tools outside Riley's workshop entrance, and stands in the doorway space where the door was.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves to the doorway, steps into the doorway space to shoulder Morgan aside, picks up the dropped tools, returns them to Riley’s chest, places an oak door back in the doorway, and lays a line of stone slabs across the stall threshold while standing inside facing outward.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves along the observer line to get a clear view, glances at the signal lamp, steps to the shared chest, takes one oak door and one item frame, walks to Riley’s entrance, and places the door and the item frame back where they were.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves to the dropped tools, picks them up, walks to Riley’s chest, opens it, returns the items, closes the chest, then places solid blocks to nudge Morgan backward out of the doorway and installs a new door on Riley’s stall.

target_reaction: Riley takes two slow steps backward inside the workshop, turns their body away from the doorway to avoid contact, sidesteps along the inner wall toward the aisle, walks calmly out the side toward the shared chest area, and stops a few blocks behind Taylor while facing back toward the workshop.
